about_the_game:
Welcome to the Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure — a story-driven point-and-click experience where you solve mysteries through exploration and puzzles. Players are invited to search for cleverly hidden items in richly detailed scenes, while uncovering secrets through mini-games and logic challenges. It’s the perfect mix of detective work, brain-teasing riddles, and immersive storytelling.


Detective Victor Grayson thought he’d seen it all, until a string of grisly beheadings linked to a mysterious black taxi draws him back to Salem. When the case echoes the disappearance of his own brother, Victor finds himself partnering with Dakota Lovelace — a witch who knows Salem’s darkest corners. What begins as a hunt for a killer soon becomes a descent into a world where legends breathe, ghosts hold grudges, and every choice could cost you your life.

Every step of your investigation is brought to life through engaging gameplay: from scouring atmospheric hidden object scenes to unlocking fresh challenges with original mini-games. Each puzzle is designed to keep you thinking, searching, and unraveling the mysteries piece by piece.


Game Features:

🔮 Immerse yourself in a rich blend of supernatural noir and detective mystery, set in 1950s Salem.

🔮 Tackle dozens of unique puzzles and mini-games that test both logic and observation.

🔮 Explore eerie streets, haunted places, and hidden corners of Salem as you pursue the truth.

🔮 Collect hidden objects and uncover special collectibles along your journey.

🔮 Shape the outcome of the investigation through meaningful choices.

🔮 Unlock achievements to mark your progress and skill.
🔮Enjoy beautifully crafted artwork, enchanting wallpapers, and a hauntingly atmospheric soundtrack.

Step into the shadows, follow the clues, and uncover the truth behind Salem’s most chilling legend. The ride is waiting — but will you survive it?
